# Jubbio Developer Documentation

> Complete developer platform & API specification for the Jubbio real-time chat & community ecosystem. Optimized for LLMs, AI coding assistants, and bot developers.

## Core Platform Facts
- REST API Base URL: `https://gateway.jubbio.com/api/v1`
- Gateway WebSocket URL: `wss://gateway.jubbio.com/`
- OAuth2 Authorization URL: `https://jubbio.com/oauth2/authorize`
- OAuth2 Token URL: `https://gateway.jubbio.com/api/v1/oauth2/token`
- Developer Portal: `https://jubbio.com/dev`
- Bot Authorization Header: `Authorization: Bot <BOT_TOKEN>`
- User Authorization Header: `Authorization: Bearer <USER_ACCESS_TOKEN>`
- Serialization: JSON with `omitempty` conventions.
- Identifier Format: 64-bit integer Snowflake IDs passed as strings.

## Official Libraries
- `@jubbio/core`: Client, Gateway WebSocket connection, REST API manager, Builders, Interactions, PermissionsBitField.
- `@jubbio/voice`: Voice UDP connection, AudioPlayer, AudioResource, voice stream management.
- `@jubbio/auth` & `@jubbio/auth-react`: OAuth2 PKCE authentication SDK and React components (`JubbioAuthProvider`, `JubbioLoginButton`, `useJubbio`).

## Full Specifications
- [Complete Reference Manual](JUBBIO_DEV_REFERENCE.md): Comprehensive documentation covering all REST endpoints, Gateway events, interaction handlers, builders, permissions bitfields, collectors, sharding, and error scenarios.
- [Full Text for Ingestion](llms-full.txt): Complete plaintext representation for direct LLM context injection.
